scope: After the separately pinned Ubuntu codec-source acquisition succeeds, stream one bounded gzip archive containing only receipt-verified libjxl source members, the frozen spatial bridge snapshot, the six exact CharLS/OpenJPEG Debian source inputs, and selected provider notice texts. Read back every member hash. This does not build providers or establish release closure.
acceptance: The run requires the successful immutable-input receipt from ubuntu-codec-source-inputs-v1 before it creates an archive.
Before creating an output, the runner reserves a 250000000-byte archive allowance and a 4000000-byte receipt allowance within the shared 4000000000-byte work limit.

The archive contains exactly the 4094 receipt-listed libjxl source files, every frozen spatial bridge source member, all six pinned CharLS/OpenJPEG Debian source descriptor/component archives, selected provider notice texts, and generated identity/instructions files.

The archive writer enforces its byte allowance while writing and performs a complete read-back member-hash verification. The receipt records all input identities and makes no source-to-binary, rebuild, redistribution, or release claim.
